narrative: Demand for PL3__M86D611C shows a statistically significant downward trend (slope -0.91 units/day, p<0.001), declining from ~475 to ~240 units/day over the observation window. Lead times are highly variable (CV=0.65, range 0.69-4.76 days), contributing 64% of total sigma_LTD variance. An (r,Q) fixed-reorder-point policy was selected with storage-capped order quantity of 5,922 units, reducing total annual costs by 45.4% while establishing a proper 718-unit safety buffer for 95% service level.
warnings: Storage capacity binds: EOQ of 42,324 units reduced to 5,922 units (max_storage - safety_stock). Capacity utilization at 99.99%. Demand downtrend may cause overstock risk — quarterly policy review recommended.

research_insights.selected_model: (r,Q) Fixed Reorder Point with EOQ-derived order quantity
research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is mostly continuous (74.6% non-zero working days) with moderate CV (0.241), making a fixed reorder point model appropriate. The (r,Q) policy triggers replenishment when stock hits the ROP of 1,253 units and orders a fixed quantity of 5,922 units, balancing ordering and holding costs while respecting the storage ceiling.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity hard-caps order quantity at 5,922 units (vs. unconstrained EOQ of 42,324). At 99.99% capacity utilization, any increase in safety stock or MOQ would breach the storage limit. The downward demand trend also poses overstock risk if the policy is not refreshed quarterly.
